distance_observation: Both released volume evaluators call medpy.metric.binary.hd95 without voxel spacing, after reconstructing each 3D volume. Swin-Unet test.py averages cases then foreground classes. These are voxel/index-grid distances, not the resized 2D pixel distances in panel A. Source empty-mask branches differ from ours.
publication_labels: Original Synapse tables label the distance HD. Keep that source label in panel B; released code supports a 95th-percentile implementation but does not prove the exact historical run produced by current released code. TransUNet caption says mm despite omitted voxel spacing.
missing_metrics: EGE-UNet/LB-UNet original tables: DSC and mIoU, no Boundary F1 or distance. TransUNet/Swin-Unet cited ACDC tables: DSC only. No values imported from other protocols.
isic_aggregation: Pinned LB-UNet engine flattens all predictions/masks before computing DSC from pooled pixel counts; EGE-UNet engine does likewise. Different from our per-image DSC mean.
